approvers: Just me; my site foreman and the developer client would have a say
reason: Film and tape cost me almost nothing and my guys put it on and take it off themselves. At about €19/m² on a €210k turnover business this would eat my margin on jobs where the client never asks for it.
objection: I am paying roughly 20 to 40 times what film costs per m², plus a 50% deposit up front and a 150 m² minimum, for something no client has asked me to provide.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and masking tape from the local hardware store, applied by my own crew.
would_change_my_mind: A client or developer who specifies it and pays for it as a separate line in the contract, so it costs me nothing out of margin.
